shortDescription: Manage snapshot policies on Dell PowerFlex

options.name: access_mode
options.description: Access mode of the snapshot policy. READ_ONLY access_mode is allowed only since PowerFlex 5.0.

options.name: auto_snapshot_creation_cadence
options.description: The auto snapshot creation cadence of the snapshot policy.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: new_name
options.description: New name of the snapshot policy.

options.name: num_of_retained_snapshots_per_level
options.displayName: Num Of Retained Snapshots Per Level
options.description: Number of retained snapshots per level.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: pause
options.description: Whether to pause or resume the snapshot policy.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: secure_snapshots
options.description: Whether to secure snapshots or not. Used only in the create operation.

options.name: snapshot_policy_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the snapshot policy. Except create operation, all other operations can be performed using I(snapshot_policy_id). Mutually exclusive with I(snapshot_policy_name).

options.name: snapshot_policy_name
options.description: The name of the snapshot policy. It is unique across the PowerFlex array. Mutually exclusive with I(snapshot_policy_id).

options.name: source_volume
options.description: The source volume details to be added or removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
